name: Strain Creation API
author: Ben
summary: Library that lets mods add strains and zero-heat bonuses to the game's own Custom strain screen.
description:
Install it when a strain mod requires it. Mods can add rules and helpful bonuses you choose before a run, with saved selection and run behavior. Version 1.1.0 adds support for custom bonuses.

On the Custom strain screen, arrows beside the STRAINS title open MOD STRAINS pages. Regular strains use the main grid and add their heat to the gauge. Mod bonuses use the blue bonus column and add no heat; vanilla bonuses stay on the vanilla page. A run keeps its chosen mod strains and bonuses through quitting and continuing.

Console commands (F10): `strain` shows the next run's picks and the active run's modifiers. Use `strain list`, `strain info <id>`, `strain on <id>`, `strain off <id|all>`, `strain apply <id>` and `strain remove <id>` to inspect or change them. Screen selection applies to Custom runs; `strain apply` can add a modifier to an existing run.
